marketNotes.text: 2026-10-23: 123inkt.nl raised the HPE C7976A LTO-6 cartridge from 39.50 to 53.50 incl. VAT, so the cheapest LTO-6 cartridge is now Fujifilm (48.84 on Amazon.nl, 49.50 at 123inkt).

2026-10-23: older HPE internal drives jumped at Bechtle and Senetic: BB873A (LTO-7) went from 5,608.35 to 8,574.06 at Bechtle NL, and Senetic now lists BC022A (LTO-8) at 11,097.71 against 5,636.05 in September (out of stock, enquiry only).
2026-10-23: the Kaufland.nl marketplace drive offers that Beslist showed in September are gone, and Galaxus raised the Quantum TC-L82AN-BR LTO-8 internal drive from 5,629 to 6,869.
2026-10-23: LTO-10 30 TB cartridges start at 257.72 incl. VAT (HPE Q2080A, Bechtle NL); Galaxus lists the Quantum LTO-10 at 269 and the Fujifilm 40 TB cartridge at 749 (729 in September).

Tweakers Pricewatch, Azerty, Informatique, Megekko, Dustin.nl (ex-Centralpoint), bol.com, Galaxus, Kaufland, Conrad, PrintAbout, Proshop, DiscountOffice, Vocas, HPE Store and Lenovo block scripted access; their offers appear only where Kieskeurig or Beslist listed them, with the comparison URL.
DigiNet and two Beslist search pages (lto-10, lto-worm) refuse scripted requests but load in a normal browser; those prices were read there.
Centralpoint.nl now redirects to Dustin.nl; Dustin.be (Belgium) still serves pages with embedded prices.
ARP.nl (Bechtle group) showed the same price as Bechtle NL for HPE Q2079A (112.52 incl. VAT), so ARP is not listed as separate datapoints.
Bechtle BE and Bechtle NL price the same SKUs differently (e.g. Quantum MR-L10MQN-01: 417.44 BE vs 343.63 NL incl. VAT).
Aces Direct lists media at roughly double other Dutch sellers; its prices are recorded excl. VAT as shown in the page's price field.
Tapes.nl shows prices for Symply drives only; HPE and Quantum drives there are quote-only.
No LTO-10 half-height or internal drive with a public price was found in NL/BE; Bechtle NL lists LTO-10 media but no LTO-10 drive, and the LTO-10 desktop units seen are full-height Symply models.
HPE's newer external drive SKU P84142-B25 is sold as a bundle with 5 LTO-9 cartridges.
LTO-10 40 TB cartridges seen only as Quantum MR-A10MQN-01 at Bechtle NL/BE (backorder) and a Fujifilm 40TB listing at Galaxus.nl.
Many Bechtle drive prices are for items marked 'Bestel nu en we verzenden dit artikel zodra het beschikbaar is' (backorder); some Quantum kit SKUs (-EY, -FZ) are priced far below the bare drive.

Senetic.nl carries HPE and Dell LTO media and HPE drives; it lists no Fujifilm, IBM or Quantum LTO-6 to LTO-10 cartridges. Several of its items show 'Niet beschikbaar in het magazijn' and can only be requested.
Alternate.nl lists a single LTO cartridge (Quantum LTO-9); Alternate.be carries IBM, HPE and Quantum LTO-6 to LTO-9 media but no LTO drives.
DigiNet shows a 5% web discount off suggested retail price, but its structured data marks all LTO media out of stock.
TopTen Storage (Germany) ships LTO drives to NL/BE but quotes German 19% VAT, so it is excluded from this Dutch layer.
New LTO-6 drives appear only as Amazon.nl marketplace offers and Kaufland.nl or Amazon offers listed on Beslist.
PrintAbout, Conrad, 123inkt and Fnac.be charge about 4.95 to 11.90 shipping on single cartridges; most other sellers ship free.
